ideas.pitch: A pre-commit code refactoring tool designed to prepare codebase structures specifically for unexpected mid-event modifications.
ideas.title: VibeCode Mod-Guard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses Round 3's twist constraint where AI tools are banned by creating automated modularity rules while free Claude and Gemini are still available in earlier rounds.

ideas.pitch: A prompt and state management utility that compresses large application context into minimal tokens to stay safely within free-tier limits.
ideas.title: Gemini Context Squeezer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Crucial for winning since the rules explicitly state participants must use free tiers of Claude and Gemini and manage their own usage limits.

ideas.pitch: A local development helper that cross-references code snippets generated by Claude and Gemini to catch discrepancies or hallucinations before integration.
ideas.title: Dual-LLM Cross-Validator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly leverages the permitted tools (only Claude and Gemini) while offering judges a reliable technical edge during rapid vibe coding.

ideas.pitch: A rapid component generation suite that outputs zero-dependency vanilla JavaScript and CSS components for rapid prototyping without heavy frameworks.
ideas.title: Vanilla Vibe UI Builder
ideas.why_it_could_win: Ensures codebases remain clean and easy to refactor manually when the AI-ban twist hits in Round 3.

ideas.pitch: A lightning-fast local documentation search and snippet injector utilizing local markdown files to bypass potential network limits during restricted web searches.
ideas.title: Offline Docs Cache
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a dependable utility during the hackathon when internet access or search APIs might experience throttling.
